column1: # The closed classes: a subcategory per row, one cell (`word`, the lemma). The

# cases a preposition governs (commonest first, from the treebank census),
# `pros=encl|procl` the word's place in the accentual unit. Written by hand
# (2.2 Part 2); the lexicon lines are the Polyakov importer's.
